page_title: HAV 0-3 LIL | Le Havre v Lille 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Arthur Desmas anticipates the direction of the penalty by Angel Gomes (Lille). He attempted to put the ball inside the right post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
90+4' Angel Gomes (Lille) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' Bastien Dechepy shows the yellow card to Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) for a heavy challenge.
90+3' Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul. That is a penalty kick for Lille.

90+2' Ethan Mbappe (Lille) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
90+2' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' Arthur Desmas was forced into action to thwart Mitchel Bakker (Lille). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
85' Substitution. Ethan Mbappe (Lille) on for Edon Zhegrova.

84' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
83' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) replaces Benjamin Andre.
82' Here comes a substitution. Thomas Meunier (Lille) is brought on as a substitute for Tiago Santos.
79' 0 - 3 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) makes the score 0:3 after burying a close-range header in the bottom right corner after a good run and cross by Edon Zhegrova.
74' Lucas Chevalier (Lille) is able to continue to play.
74' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Gabriel Gudmundsson and he is replaced by Mitchel Bakker (Lille).
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Remy Cabella (Lille) for Osame Sahraoui.
73' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Chevalier (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
68' Benjamin Andre (Lille) is awarded a yellow card.
67' Tiago Santos (Lille) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
65' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post.
65' It will be a corner kick for Le Havre.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is penalised for holding. Bastien Dechepy signals a set piece. A free kick to Le Havre.
62' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Lucas Chevalier.
59' Substitution. Loic Nego did his best and is replaced by Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josue Casimir departs the field of play to be replaced by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre).
59' Didier Digard prepares a substitution. Antoine Joujou is replaced by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre).
58' The substitution is prepared. Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yassine Kechta.
57' Loic Nego (Le Havre) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
56' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
53' Loic Nego (Le Havre) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
49' Lucas Chevalier pulls off a run-of-the-mill save from a header by Issa Soumare (Le Havre) after a cross from the side.
46' The whistle blows and Bastien Dechepy starts the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Le Havre.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) has received a yellow card for his foul.
43' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

35' 0 - 2 It's a goal! Jonathan David (Lille) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the bottom right corner. The assist goes to Osame Sahraoui and the score changes to 0:2.
34' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is adjudged offside.
33' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) blows a big chance from close range. World class save by the goalkeeper.

32' Bafode Diakite (Lille) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Arthur Desmas, who pulls off a comfortable save!
32' Lille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
31' Lille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lille are going to take it.
31' Jonathan David (Lille) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort. Now Lille have a corner.
31' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lille.
30' Tiago Santos (Lille) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
29' Tiago Santos (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) tries to catch the keeper off guard from long range, but the effort sails well wide of the right post.
26' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Lucas Chevalier.

23' 0 - 1 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a brilliant pass and fires a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. Osame Sahraoui assisted in the goal. 0:1.
20' It looked like the long-range shot by Edon Zhegrova (Lille) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
20' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' A player from Le Havre takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Lille are awarded the free kick.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Angel Gomes (Lille).
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lille.
14' Loic Nego (Le Havre) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
10' Benjamin Andre (Lille) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.

10' Alexsandro (Lille) latches on to a fine cross from the resulting corner kick and slams the ball in from close range. He should have aimed better, however, as he hit his own teammate in front of him.
10' Le Havre win a corner.
9' Jonathan David (Lille) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
7' Andre Gomes (Lille) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

6' Jonathan David (Lille) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.
4' The Lille players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Le Havre will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Bastien Dechepy.
